signatures.description: Uses Windows utilities for basic Windows functionality

T1053.long: Utilities such as at and schtasks, along with the Windows Task Scheduler, can be used to schedule programs or scripts to be executed at a date and time. A task can also be scheduled on a remote system, provided the proper authentication is met to use RPC and file and printer sharing is turned on. Scheduling a task on a remote system typically required being a member of the Administrators group on the the remote system.

strings: PERSONAL PROTECTIVE PRODUCT(PPE)/MEDICAL EQUIPMENTS BULK SUPPLY.

In view of the adequate preparation for COVID-19 third wave, The Iraq Reconstruction Management Office(IRMO) has a sole responsibility of sourcing for reputable companies/individuals/NGOs from around the world to supply Anti-Covid-19 Products to Iraq Government, we are been mandated to partner with the Iraq Ministry of Trade(IMOT) to solicit, evaluate and recommend reputable foreign companies/individuals/NGOs interested with the capability to supply us with the under-listed products/specifications.

I would like to discuss the possibility of your company with email address: stoolouplilla@jetfix.ee partaking in immediate bulk supply of Personal Protective Equipment(PPE) and hospital/Medical equipment, this is part of our ongoing sourcing of bulk medical supplies to help combat this COVID-19 pandemic and contract supply strategies aimed at equipping all our general hospitals/Laboratories scattered in all the 19 provinces in Iraq at this particular period under the "THE PROJECT RE-BUILD IRAQ" initiative; in this light your company with email address: stoolouplilla@jetfix.ee has been shortlisted, we therefore implore you to in

The Iraq Reconstruction Management Office(IRMO/MOF) is interested in immediate bulk supplies(as a matter of urgency) the following under-listed COVID-19 PPE Products according to the Descriptions, Compositions and Specifications as illustrated below;
Certification type: EN 14683 (higher standard than custom request) TYPE II.
Product: HARLEY L-188 NIOSH N95 Face Mask.
(iii) KN95 with Chinese standard GB2626;
(iv) Surgical Disposable Isolation Gowns Class 2;
Material: 100% polypropylene non-woven fabric with PE coating film 42 g/m2.
Style: Long sleeve, Round neck, Elastic cuff, Neck tie and waist tie.
(v) Sars-CoV-2 Antigen Rapid Test Kit;
(vi) Rapid Antibody IgM/IgG Covid-19 Test;
Qualitative Percentage: SARS-CoV-2 Infection in human whole blood 92.9% accuracy to determine if the Covid-19 Virus is present.
(vii) Disinfectant wipes 6 x 8 inch wipes;
Main ingredient: Made with plant based alcohol.
(i) Must be made According to GB15979.
(ii) Wipes must reach the bacteriostatic rate at 2 and remain active on surfaces to disinfect, at 5 or 10 minutes and longer.
(ix) Avante Verdana MC ICU Ventilator;
Ventilator Dimensions: 17.9" x 15.7" x 11.8"(45.5 x 40 x 30 cm)
Trolley Dimensions: 22.2" x 21.1" x 35.8"(56.5 x 53.5 x 91 cm)
Respiratory Modes: VCV, PCV, SIMV-VC+ PSV, SIMV-PC+PSV,SPONT (CPAP/PSV),BIPAP, APRV, V
Weight: < 6.5 lbs with disposable battery andelectrodes (2.9 kg).
Design Standards: Meets or exceeds AAMI DF-80, EN 60601-1, EN 60601-1-2.
Patient Safety: All patient connections are electrically isolated.
Autonomy: Up to one week in standby mode
Charging method: charging USB or battery
DELIVERY TERMS: Our preferable delivery is through sea Shipment on CIF delivery terms to our port of destination Umm Al Qasr Port, Iraq.
DELIVERY PERIOD: 30 to 90 days after full payment.
DOCUMENTS REQUIRED FROM SELLER UPON 100% PAYMENT:
(i) Full set of B/L Documents(3 originals and 3 copies).
(ii) Commercial invoice(3 originals and 3 copies).
PAYMENT OPTIONS: Payment of contract supplies are 100% upon approval of your Invoice by Iraq Ministry of finance(MOF).

MODE OF TRANSFER: Transfer is initiated by TELEX TRANSFER(TT) by the Central Bank of Iraq(CBI) to your company nominated bank account via/in collaboration with the Central Bank of Iraq(CBI) offshore Fiduciary agents/banks before the supply and delivery commences or by the issuance of a STANDBY LETTER OF CREDIT(SBLC).
Upon confirmation of your willingness to supply us, we shall open a more robust channel of communication with you.

Statement of Confidentiality: This message and and attachments are intended for the persons named as addressees only and may contain confidential information. In addition they may be protected by copyright. If you receive it in error, notify us, delete it and do not make use of or copy it.
